website_summary.name: Flashcard Learning Hub
website_summary.description: The website features a clean, organized interface with a sidebar for navigation, a search bar for quick access, and a central area displaying flashcard collections and decks.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a well-structured layout with a sidebar on the left containing options for Profile, Login, Logout, and sections for Collections and Decks. The sidebar includes a toggle button at the bottom right corner for expanding or collapsing. The main display area in the center showcases details about the selected collection or deck, including flashcard questions and answers. The top header includes a search bar and icons for switching between light and dark themes. The design uses a combination of white and gray backgrounds with blue accents for buttons and links, ensuring a modern and user-friendly appearance.
website_summary.functionality: The website offers several key functionalities: users can navigate through different collections and decks using the sidebar, perform searches via the top search bar, and switch between light and dark themes. Clicking on specific collections or decks allows users to view detailed flashcard information in the main display area. The sidebar entries for collections and decks are designed to allow partial interaction—clicking the left half switches the sidebar view without changing the main display, while clicking the right half affects only the main display. Additionally, the website supports user authentication with Login and Logout options.

2. General Deck : Text indicating the current deck
3. About Collection Card : Card providing information about the General Collection
4. Flashcards Card : Card listing flashcards within the General Deck
5. Sidebar Navigation Card : Card containing navigation options like Profile, Login, Logout, Collections, and Decks
6. General Collection Entry : Represents a collection entry in the sidebar
7. Search Box : Input field for searching content
8. Dark Mode Button : Button to switch to dark mode
9. Profile Button : Button linking to profile settings
10. Login Button : Button for logging in
11. Logout Button : Button for logging out
12. Collections Button : Button for accessing collections
13. Programming Collection : Text indicating another collection
14. Product Management Collection : Text indicating another collection
15. Decks Button : Button for accessing decks
